g.text: Core · one byte walk, one handler per opcode
drag and drop a file or folder — same two modes
the SoF server's `user/<mod>/ds/` — where `.os` is really loaded
the exe is win32-only — on Linux it is run under wine
`parseOpcodes` gets the stream at +4 — the leading int32 is the version
`switch` on the opcode byte, then a `handle*` per family
`PushStack` / `PopStack` — the expression stack, replayed in reverse
`Variables` + `Fields` — name to global index, rebuilt per file
`FixUps` — raw jump offsets resolved to `label_N` at the end
`decompiled.ds` — rewritten per file, no merge, no backup
`helper.ds` — the define wall every output includes
